exampleEn: We are all tremendously happy for you and your fiancé.

exampleEn: We should always teach young children to be kind to animals.

exampleEn: Staff members are trained to remain polite to all patrons.

meaning: độc lập với/không phụ thuộc vào

exampleEn: Her family has always been wholeheartedly supportive of her career choices.

exampleEn: The border authorities were suspicious of his fraudulent passport.

exampleEn: My little sister has always been scared of spiders.

exampleEn: She became acutely conscious of the impression she was making.

exampleEn: He was completely unaware of the strict parking regulations.

exampleEn: The host community was exceptionally friendly towards visitors.

exampleEn: Regular cardiovascular exercise is exceptionally good for heart health.

meaning: được biết đến với tư cách là
